options.content:
Received counter estimates for the selected window. Delayed telemetry may be absent; no data is not zero. Routing selection share does not establish cost savings or model quality.

Latency histograms include failed Jev attempts. Sparse/idle worker samples can leave gaps. Use **Query inspector** to distinguish datasource failures from no data.

Delivery health is the last received snapshot. Workers exit after five minutes per run; later calls restart them; last-success trails by one flush. Health panels ignore the agent/project/user filters. Coalesced and dropped health counters show lifetime totals from the last received snapshot.

Financial panels report known Jev charges only. OpenRouter balances are separate account-wide snapshots and may be stale; inspect age and probe status. Unpriced requests do not imply free calls or savings.

panels.description: Latest successful snapshot per account alias and API scope across installations, independent of router project/user/agent/instance filters. panels.title: Historical routing calls · direct identity unavailable
panels.description: Historical `rule:*` observations are retained but excluded from direct selected and submitted views. Their parent-derived identity cannot be reconstructed. Raw VM history remains unchanged.

panels.title: Jev tokens · reported input / output
panels.description: Reported Jev tokens only. Input and output coverage are independent; missing usage is unknown, not zero. Existing history has no retroactive coverage. Selected routing cohorts; window estimates.

panels.title: Jev token coverage · input / output
panels.description: Known-token requests divided by all Jev requests in the selected window and cohorts. Pre-upgrade requests without coverage counters remain unmeasured and count as unknown. Input/output are independent. Missing or inconsistent request totals do not imply complete coverage.

panels.title: Observed hook versions · last hook age
panels.description: Observed executing hook versions within instance/user/client filters, independent of project. Per reporter the smallest age is the latest observed hook, not necessarily the newest release; all historical versions remain visible. Gauge value is actual hook time; worker re-exports do not refresh it. This is not an installed-version inventory. Missing metadata and idle/unreported installations are unknown. Plugin version and invoking Claude Code/Codex agent_version are separate from the model. Missing historical client version is unknown; distinct client versions remain separate rows.
